summary.intent: Manage the cipher-box v2.0 milestone via the GSD manager dashboard: review phase status, resolve a stalled Phase 69, dispatch Phase 70 planning, and discuss Phase 71 (share-invite security & IPNS data-integrity) to lock implementation decisions.
summary.outcome: Phase 69 was confirmed already merged (PR #594, CI green, verification 5/5) and marked complete in GSD despite a stale 'partial' disk status; Phase 70 planning was dispatched in the background; Phase 71 discussion was completed with root-ownership, CID-equivocation guard, and other decisions locked and written to CONTEXT.md/DISCUSSION-LOG.md, but the session ended before deciding how to commit those deliverables given a parallel background agent still writing to the shared working tree.

repo: GSD manager's init.manager derives phase status from a `*PLAN*.md` glob that miscounted the research file `69-WRITE-PLANE-RESEARCH.md` as a 26th plan, making a fully complete Phase 69 (25/25 plans+summaries) show as `partial`; `gsd_run query verify phase-completeness <N>` is the accurate/strict counter to trust instead

`.claude/settings.local.json` is gitignored and safe to edit for local-only overrides (e.g. bgIsolation); `.claude/settings.json` is committed shared config and should not be changed for personal workarounds

GSD's bg-isolation guard blocks direct Write to `.planning/` while a background agent is active in the same working tree; the documented escape hatch is `bgIsolation: "none"` in settings.local.json, chosen over a worktree because worktrees would fragment shared GSD planning state across the manager, a parallel plan agent, and the user
Repo enforces a no-direct-commit-to-main rule, which conflicts with committing discuss-phase deliverables while another background agent (plan-70) is actively writing to the same checkout on main

code.finding: `vaults.owner_id` is a real unique FK to users.id (one vault per user) and holds `root_ipns_name`, but has no `root_node_id` column, so a root's nodeId can't be server-validated without a schema change
`ipns_records.user_id` is documented as a denormalized creator marker only — authority is proven by record signature, not row ownership, so it shouldn't be treated as authoritative for access checks

createInvite copies `dto.rootIpnsName` and `dto.rootNodeId` verbatim from untrusted client input with no server-side ownership lookup — any authenticated user can mint an invite for any well-formed ipnsName

`vaults.root_ipns_name` is itself client-asserted at vault init, so no store in the system proves cryptographic key possession — ownership checks only prove 'first authenticated user to register this ipnsName'
renewIpnsRecord re-signs the value+sequence parsed from the existing record; the request body has no metadataCid field, so the TEE lease-renewer structurally cannot repoint the CID
TEE republish uses a separate EOL-only write path that never touches `latestCid`, confirming it can't produce a same-sequence CID change
Client publish always bumps the sequence number on any content change, so a same-sequence retry always resends the identical CID
The 'Pitfall 4' test simulates a same-seq-different-CID TEE republish scenario that Phase 67's contract rewrite made impossible — test is stale and needs rewriting
Comment describes a TEE re-signing behavior that no longer matches the post-Phase-67 contract; misleading and needs updating

workflow: On Claude Code runtime, GSD manager runs plan/execute inline (not backgrounded) — only Codex runtime backgrounds them, per manager.md's runtime resolution logic

When a phase's disk status looks wrong, cross-check multiple sources (manifest, ROADMAP checkbox, VERIFICATION.md, merged PR/CI status, strict `verify phase-completeness` command) before concluding it's genuinely incomplete vs. a stale/miscounted marker

Before locking a load-bearing design decision (e.g. root-ownership), trace actual code flows with a scout/sub-agent rather than reasoning abstractly — it surfaced a purpose-built authoritative entity (vaults table) that wasn't part of the original framing

friction: Phase 69 appeared stalled/partial in the dashboard despite being fully merged and verified, requiring several rounds of manual investigation (manifest, verification doc, CI status, plan/summary file matching) to confirm it was safe to mark complete
Write tool was blocked by the bg-isolation guard because a background Phase 70 planning agent was concurrently active in the same working tree, requiring a settings.local.json edit to proceed
Session ended mid-decision on how to commit Phase 71's discuss deliverables, since the repo's no-direct-main-commit rule conflicts with a parallel background agent actively using the same checkout
open_items: GSD manager's plan-counting glob still miscounts research files as plans (cosmetic bug causing false 'partial' status) — not fixed, explicitly left out of scope
rootNodeId remains client-asserted and unvalidated server-side for Phase 71 (SC#1 only half-checkable) unless a root_node_id column is added to vaults
SC#3's proposed ipns_records partial index was flagged for revision/removal since vaults.owner_id uniqueness already enforces one-root-per-user
Stale Pitfall-4 test (ipns.service.spec.ts:2124,2131) and misleading comment (ipns.service.ts:313) need rewriting — deferred to the planner via CONTEXT.md riders
Git commit strategy for Phase 71's CONTEXT.md/DISCUSSION-LOG.md deliverables was unresolved at session end due to conflict with the parallel background Phase 70 agent on main
